correctness.rationale: For any d≥3, dual faces are complete graph edges, two-path triangles, and square tetrahedra; triangle-free cubical graph has no larger face. Each path triangle and distance-two diagonal is confined to one coordinate square, giving two free-face collapse steps per square without interaction. Remaining cubical 2-skeleton is simply connected with H2 rank A_d; long Hamming-distance≥3 edges give B_d H1 loops. Integral combinatorial Alexander duality and full (N−6)-skeleton of cut complex give homology in dimensions N−5 and N−4, and the (N−6)-connected (N−4)-dimensional CW space splits as the claimed wedge. Independently rechecked combinatorial A_d,B_d for d=3..6 (1,4),(7,40),(31,256),(111,1344); finite checks do not establish all d.
